summary: Fastidious announces a promo code and giveaway for a physical Dark Lady statue in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. He reviews the bonus rewards available via his referral link, which includes free heroes Auster and Cervinia. He highlights the strengths of Auster as a top Frost DPS for story and boss progression, as well as his favorite hero Child of Chaos. Additionally, he briefly mentions rumors regarding an upcoming rerun for Anneliesis.

heroes.name: Auster
heroes.note: Excellent AoE and single-target DPS that excels in story progression, story bosses, and magichess.

heroes.name: Cervinia
heroes.note: Solid support hero provided for free via creator download link.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Highly versatile unit capable of element shifting, healing, supporting, and executing enemies.

heroes.name: Hvitar
heroes.note: Strong Frost exclusive hero that pairs exceptionally well alongside Auster in double DPS compositions.

heroes.name: The Dark Lady
heroes.note: Rare and powerful Necrosis hero that dispels shields, inflicts debuffs, and buffs allies.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Rumored to be returning in a video/banner very soon.

tips: Redeem the promo code fastidious14 in Settings > Redemption Code Pack to receive 350 Wyrmarrow, 5 Starlight Stone Dice, and 50,000 Gold.
New players can download the game via the creator link to receive free copies of Cervinia (Epic) and Auster (Legendary).
title: I'm Giving Away This FREE STATUE Again! ⁂ Dragonheir: Silent Gods
